normalization_plan.reason: from is a function-scoped parameter of _transfer used only for local validation and indexing; merge it into the _transfer node
to is a function-scoped parameter of _transfer used only for local validation and cooldown writes; merge it into the _transfer node
amount is a function-scoped parameter of _transfer used only for its own require and to forward value; merge it into the _transfer node
tokenAmount is the sole input of swapTokensForEth and has no other scope; merge it into the swapTokensForEth node
bots_ is the array parameter iterated only inside setBots; merge it into the setBots node
notbot is the single parameter written by delBot and used nowhere else; merge it into the delBot node
tAmount is a local of _transferStandard that only feeds _getValues; merge it into the _transferStandard node
contractTokenBalance is a local of _transfer that is immediately passed to swapTokensForEth; merge it into the _transfer node
contractETHBalance is a local of _transfer used only to guard the sendETHToFee call; merge it into the _transfer node
